## Overview for AI Agents & LLMs

This document is specifically curated to serve as a **machine-readable and human-readable skill reference for Large Language Models (LLMs)**—including Google DeepMind Antigravity, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI ChatGPT, Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor—as well as bioinformatics researchers using AI assistants.

It documents:
- The S3 object architecture of `tidyproteomics`.
- All supported mass spectrometry data formats and configuration schemas (`supported_formats`).
- Complete, exhaustive API reference for all exported functions (`api_reference`).
- Canonical recipes for common end-to-end workflows.
- Best practices and gotchas for prompt engineering and automated script generation.

### Exporting the Skill Locally

You can export the raw `SKILL.md` file directly into your working directory (or into `.agents/skills/` / `.cursor/rules/`) at any time using:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(tidyproteomics)

# Export SKILL.md to the current working directory
export_llm_skill()

# Or export to a specific custom location (e.g. for an AI agent)
export_llm_skill(destination = ".agents/skills/tidyproteomics")
```

### Ready-to-Use Prompt Templates for Researchers

To assist researchers asking an LLM *"What is interesting about this dataset?"*, `tidyproteomics` provides ready-to-use prompt templates via `prompt_template()`:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Phase 1: Retrieve prompt to extract dataset metadata and check quality
prompt_template("profiling")

# Phase 2: Retrieve biological discovery prompt ("What's interesting about this dataset?")
prompt_template("discovery")

# Targeted two-sample contrast prompt
prompt_template("pairwise")

# Multi-condition / screen analysis prompt
prompt_template("multicontrast")

# Venn diagram and segment extraction prompt
prompt_template("extracting")
```

---

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}
# Locate and load the SKILL.md document bundled with tidyproteomics
skill_path <- system.file("extdata", "SKILL.md", package = "tidyproteomics")

if (skill_path == "" || !file.exists(skill_path)) {
  candidates <- c(
    file.path("..", "inst", "extdata", "SKILL.md"),
    file.path("inst", "extdata", "SKILL.md")
  )
  for (candidate in candidates) {
    if (file.exists(candidate)) {
      skill_path <- candidate
      break
    }
  }
}

if (file.exists(skill_path)) {
  skill_lines <- readLines(skill_path, warn = FALSE)
  cat(paste(skill_lines, collapse = "\n"))
} else {
  cat("**Warning**: SKILL.md could not be found in package extdata.")
}
```
